tei:div.tei:p: 307)༄༅/ bdag don gzhan don gang la'ang sbyor rung ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs 'byung gnas bzhugs so// 308)

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sku bzhi dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa legs par gsan te thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa'i ngang nas ma yengs par gsan 'tshal/ de la spyir khams gsum 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol zhing/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam bzang ston par byed pa ni bla ma dam pa nyid yin zhing*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad kyi dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba'i nor bu/ dge legs lam du 'khrid pa'i ded dpon/ nyon mongs nad rnams 'joms pa'i sman pa/ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyobs pa'i skyel ma lta bu ste/ mdor na legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gyi 'byung khungs dam pa yin par/ bka' mdo dargyu lung man ngag theg pa gong 'og 309) gsang sngags gsar snying thams cad nas dgongs bzhed gcig tu mthun pa'i lung brjod las 'das pa mchis mod kyang snyan du gsol mi 'tshal zhing*/ de nyid la yang chos kun rten cing 'brel 'byung gi rang bzhin kho na yin phyir/ bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug par byed pa la dad pa dang mos gus rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs pa gal che ste/ dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che de nyid las gang la ci 'dod kyi longs spyod 'byung ba chos nyid yin kyang*/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtser bzhugs shing mchod par ma byas na mi 'byung ba'i dpe ltar/ byin rlabs 'byung ba'i thabs la bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom zhing gsol ba 'debs pa nyid kho na 310) gtso che ba'i phyir/ des na 'di ltar du bsgom ste/ ༈ rang gi lus gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po 'di nyid skad cig gis yi dam gyi lha'i ngo bor lam gyis gsal ba'i spyi bor seng khri pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du ngo bor rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan zhing gzhon nu lo brgyad pa'i na tshod lta bu shin tu mdzes pa las kyang gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na mtshan ldan gyi thod pa 'chi med tshe bum gyis mtshan pa 'dzin cing*/ dbu la pad zhwa rgod phru dar sna rdo rje nyi zlas brgyan pa gsol ba/ sku la zab chen gyi ber phod/ dar dmar gyi chos gos/ za 'og gi ber cham dang bcas pa 311)gsol zhing gzi brjid kyi lhun chags pa/ mchan g.yon du yum chen mtsho rgyal kha ṭ+waṃ gyi rnam par 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs shing thugs rje ye shes kyi 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba/ snang la rang bzhin med par stong gsal 'ja' 'od kyi skur lam mer bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ thug kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams dang/ dgongs brda' snyan brgyud bka' gter bshad sgrub sogs rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi drug gsang sngags phyi nang gi yi dam lha tshogs/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro chos srung dam can rgya mtsho sogs mdor na mchod 'os skyabs gnas byin rlabs dngos grub 312)kyi mnga' bdag thams cad la phog pas/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul zhing bdag la thugs rjes dgongs te/ snang srid thams cad rol mo'i sgra dang spos dri 'tshub cing steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun nas kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas/ rang gi spyi bo'i bla ma la sib gyis thim pas bla ma nyid gzi brjid kyi dpal du 'bar ba las kyang ches cher byin rlabs kyi 'od mdangs nyi ma 'bum ltar gsal zhing*/ thugs rje'i dgongs pa rmad du byung bas bdag la gzigs te/ bla ma sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs/ yi dam lha tshogs kyi dngos grub/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi mthu stobs sogs/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus rtsal sprug tu bdag la rgyun chad med par gnang bar gyur/

ces bsgom la/ phyi nang snang srid bdag gzhan kun gyi lus dang longs spyod mchod pa'i dngos por gyur tshad thams cad ltos pa med par 'bul zhing*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul tshig ci rigs 313) rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la phul/ slar yang deng nas bzung ste rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du skyid sdug legs nyes ci dang ci ltar byung rung re sa skyabs gnas kyi dam pa khyed las gzhan du med cing*/ bdag gzhan pha ma mkhan mnyam gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag 'khor ba ngan song ni sdug bsngal las thar nas bla med bde bde ba bla mdo bde ba chen po'i go 'phang thob pa zhig kho na mkhyenasnyam pa'i dad gus gdung shugs drag po dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ gsol bdebs rgyas bsdus gang 'os tshig don mthun par bya zhing*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma gang dang gang gi mtshan dang gsol 'debs byed kyang*/ spyi bo'i rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan chen po'i cha byad du bzhugs pa de nyid kyi ngo bo las gzhan du ma g.yos pa'i dad 'dun rtse gcig phur tshugs su byed pa ni gdams ngag gi zab gnad dam pa de/ ci'i phyir rgyal ba thams cad rnam pa so so gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul du skur bstan kyang ngo bo gcig las ma g.yos shing*/ rang rang gi snang ngor skal ba dang 'tshams 314) pa'i sku gzugs der snang ba nyid la gsol ba btab pas rgyal ba kun la gsol ba btab par 'gyur te/ ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir ro/ de skad du yang/ a ti bkod pa chen po'i rgyud las/ drin dang ldan pa'i bla ma de// snying gi dkyil lam spyi bo'i gtsug /yan lag mthil du gang bsgom pa// sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan yang*// gang zag de yi 'dzin par 'gyur/ ces dang*/ gzhan yang*/ snyan sgrub bye ba sa ya las// bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gcig dga'// nus pa 'bum phrag char mi phod/ ces pa la sogs pa'i lung brjod las 'das pa mchis shing*/ bla ma tho brtsegs su bsgom pa dang*/ khrom tshogs su bsgom pa dang/

dkyil 'khor ltar bsgom pa dang*/ gral thabs su bsgom pa sogs kyi lugs mang kyang*/ gang zag spros bcas la mos pa dag la dgongs pa yin gyis/ don du ni thams cad kun 'dus bla ma nor bu lugs su bsgom pa 'dir ma 'dus pa med cing*/ byin rlabs mchog tu myur ba'i zab gnad kyi snying po yin phyir 'di nyid la 315) 'bad par bya zhing*/ ༈ gsol 'debs kyi mthar dbang gzhi lan thabs kyang*/ sku gsung thugs dang dbang gzhi so sor dbye bar mdzad pa mang yod kyang*/ 'dir spros med chig dril du nyams su blang bar bya ste/ ༈ de ltar snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la phog sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib nyams chags thams cad dag bum gsang sher ye tshig dbang dang bcas pa thob/ lam bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid thob pa'i rten 'brel mtha' dag 'grig slar bla ma nyid 'od du ltem gyi zhu nas rang sems dang dbyer med du 'dres par gyur/ ces bsam la/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi rtog pa 316) bzang ngan gang gis kyang ma bslad cing/ dran med had por ma song ba'i gsal stong zung 'jug khyab gdal chen po'i klong du bcos slad dang bral bar mnyam par 'jog pa ni sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa zhes pa'am/ gdod ma'i gnas lugs ces sam/ chos sku'i ngo bo zhes pa yang de las logs na med pa'i phyir/ rang rig bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i phyir na gsol ba 'debs mkhan dang 'debs yul gzhan med cing ma grub pa de kho na yang dag don gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchog tu gyur pas de kho na nyid la brtson par bya zhing*/ de nyid dmigs med kyi bsngo ba'i mthar thug yin kyang*/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshig brjod par spro na/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can 'khor bar 'khyams pa rnams la dmigs te stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi ngang nas smon lam gyi rigs gang 'os brjod/

༈ slar rjes thob kyi lam 'khyer du/ rang lus yi dam lha'i nga rgyal dang spyi bo'i rigs kyi bdag po bla ma nyid 'bral med du bzhugs par mos pa'i dran pa rgyun ldan gyi ngang nas/ ngag gis smra brjod thams cad gsol 'debs 317) kho na ru dmigs/ rang nyid lam du zhugs te 'gro ba'i dus su g.yas phyogs kyi bar snang la bla ma bzhugs pa la skor ba byed par bsam/ nyal ba'i tshe rang gi snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha zum pa'i nang du bla ma bzhugs par mos/ bza' btung la longs spyod pa'i skabs su yang snying gi pad+ma kha bye bar bla ma bzhugs pa la mchod pa 'bul bar bsam/ lus la nad kyi rnam pa ci byung kyang gang du na ba'i sar bla ma'i sku chung la skye mched 'dod par gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas nad gdon sangs kyi dag par bsam/ de las gzhan pa'i dus thams cad du spyi bor bla ma bzhugs pa la mos gus dung nge ba rgyun ldan du byas pas/ rang nyid 'chi kar 'pho ba'i gdams pa yang de kas chog pa'i phyir yengs med du 'bad par bya/ de ltar 'di lta bu la rgyun ldan nyams su blang ba ni chos thams cad kyi snying po/ rig 'dzin grub thob thams cad kyi gshegs shul/ zab don gdams pa kun gyi gnad 'gag smin byed dbang bskur thams cad kyi mchog 318) gyur/ grol byed zab 'khrid thams cad kyi gtso bo/ sdig bshags sgrib sbyong thams cad kyi dam pa/ ci byed chos su 'gro ba'i man ngag yang snying du gyur pa nyid do/ gdams ngag thams cad kyi mthar thug 'di lta bu zhig la nyams len ma byas na/ deng sang snyigs dus kyi sems can tshe thung zhing g.yeng ba che ba/ 'dod pa che zhing snying rus chung ba/ blo sna mang la gang byed mthar bskyel ba nyung bas/ mi tshe hril por chos byed par brloms kyang shi ba'i dus su blo'i gtad sa ci yang med par thums kyi 'gro ba mang zhing*/ de tshe shul du dge ba byed pa la re zhing blo sna phyi la lus pa rnams ni byas pa don med mi tshe stong zad rang gi rang bslus su song ba yin pas/

des na da lta rang dbang yod dus gtan gyi mdun ma bsgrub pa'i thabs zab mo 'di lta bu la brtson te/ rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i lam bzang 'di nyid la rgyun ldan du 'bad par mdzad 'tshal/ ༈ de ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid rang gi nyams su len pa'i skabs ni yig chen gyi tshig rnams ngag don du 319) gsol 'debs gang rigs dang sbyar nas bya zhing yig chung gi don rnams sems la 'gris par bya/ gang zag gzhan la bshad pa'i tshe na ni thams cad sbrel nas bshad par bya'o/ 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes drin chen dharma'i mtshan can gyis bskul bar mdzad pa'i ngor bkod pa'o// 'dis kyang mkha' khyab 'gro ba thams cad dpal ldan bla ma mchog gi go 'phang dam pa myur du thob par gyur cig dge'o// 320)
